title: Playing GTA 6 For The FIRST Time!

clips.title: Running From Cops... To Get Fries
clips.hook: How do you lose cops on foot?
clips.reason: Fast-paced chase with a hilarious, absurd payoff (drive-thru order mid-chase); tight, visual, standalone, exactly the kind of funny GTA chaos that gets shared.

clips.title: Heist Goes Horribly Wrong
clips.hook: Why does this heist go so sideways?
clips.reason: High-tension robbery with screaming and chaos, strong hook, clear escalation and a hard stop at a threatening line - standalone and intense, exactly the chaotic GTA energy the niche wants.

clips.title: Is There A Bomb In The Car?!
clips.hook: What's that weird noise in the car?
clips.reason: Genuine tension and screaming over a bomb scare/memory scene twist, strong emotional beat and good escalation, ends on dramatic cliffhanger.

clips.title: The Moment Fame Ruins You
clips.hook: What happens once you get famous?
clips.reason: Funny riff/hot take on fame and conspiracies, good punchline about 'freak club', but less visual chaos so slightly lower energy for a gameplay-clip audience.
